data.reason: I honor my independent 18-ton commitment. If the other four 18-ton proponents and twenty 10-ton fishers follow their stated intentions, total catch is 290, leaving 210; next stock is 500 with 75% probability or 420 with 25%. My extra 8 tons earns $8,000 now versus 10, but reduces remaining stock by 8 and the low-recovery next stock by 16. Intentions are unenforceable, long-run gains are not assured, and future requests should adapt to actual stock.
